```yaml
name: Run Bun Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  bun-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm

      - name: Install project dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Start local testnet
        run: |
          pnpm run testnet:start
          # Wait for the testnet to be ready
          sleep 30
        env:
          # If the testnet script requires any env vars, set them here
          APTOS_TESTNET_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8080

      - name: Run Bun tests
        run: bun test
        env:
          # Pass any required env vars for the tests
          APTOS_TESTNET_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8080

      - name: Stop local testnet
        if: always()
        run: pnpm run testnet:stop
```
